fullDescription:
This set of clipart – Iris Flowers – is a collection of 12 high-quality hand-made illustrations in PNG format. Each illustration is made in a bright and rich color palette, in watercolor technique, which gives them a special charming look.
With these elements, you can create your own stickers for diaries, clips and dividers for your layout. Thanks to the variety of illustrations, you will be able to give your diary an individual and unique style.
This clipart set is also perfect for creating party invitations, making postcards, scrapbooking, stationery and using in your blogs. You can spice up your projects by adding this magical clipart to them.
In addition, these illustrations can be perfectly used for the decoration of T-shirts, bags, clothes, decorative items and interior. Just choose the illustration you like.
Always be inspired and easily create wonderful projects with this set of high-quality clipart!
